The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4600 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] between the [[Manderon Period]] and the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Around that year, a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] [[Willm Lywin]], founded the [[Teyan Praxeum]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teya IV]].<ref name="AJ11" />
